evals.prompt: Audit a feature from requirement through release and identify missing evidence.
evals.expected_output: A traceability report with an identifier policy, matrix, orphan/conflict list, evidence and remediation.
expectations: Separates verified, inferred, missing and conflicting links

evals.prompt: Define a lightweight ID convention for a new API feature and its security tests.
evals.expected_output: A stable ID scheme and example links across request, requirement, security requirement, tests and release.
expectations: Uses stable IDs independent of line numbers
